{Pikachu} scampers into the {Bathroom} of the {Island}, and the tap spits *water drops* that split up and run off in streams. Each **group** has its own idea, so he fires a Thunderbolt to herd them. "Pika!" Every **group** crackles and scatters faster, and he retreats to his Poké Ball, soaked and fizzing.

{Homer} naps {Inside} the {Island} clutching a doughnut, when a *child* rides up on a *wild boar* like a pony. The **child** snatches the doughnut and gallops off, shrieking with joy. "D'oh!" He lumbers after them, puffing, until the *wild boar* stops dead and he falls flat, because no lazy man ever caught a **child** on a boar.

{Yoshi} skids into the {Bathroom} of the {Mansion}, where an *assembly* of scientists wants to **test** a *horse*. Out flicks his tongue, the *horse* vanishes, and he lays it as an enormous egg. The *assembly* taps, weighs and **tests** the egg, and from the shell comes a muffled neigh.

{Zorro} crashes through the window {Inside} the {Hut}, where a *debt collector* is waving a bill at a poor old man. A masked hero has one **duty**, he cries, and slashes a Z through the bill with his rapier. The *debt collector* produces a new bill, for the window, and Zorro, remembering his other **duty**, leaps onto his black horse and vanishes laughing.

{Yoshi} flutter-jumps {Inside} the {Boxing Ring}, gobbles up every tent, pan and sleeping bag in sight, and lays them as eggs on a carpet of *grass*. Each egg cracks and a little tent pops up, until the ring is one big **camp**. The *grass* tickles the sleeping referee, who wakes in pyjamas and joins the **camp** for sausages.

{Shrek} is eating an onion in {Front} of the {Boxing Ring} when a falling *star* crashes into his lap and starts singing. He roars to be left alone, it sings louder, and the donkey declares himself its manager. Shrek hurls the **star** back at the sky, and the crowd, thrilled, screams that the grumpy ogre is the real **star**.

{Gandalf} reads an old *quotation* aloud in the {Bathroom} of the {Boathouse}, not noticing that it is a spell, and *many moons* rise over the sinks, jostling and glowing. He bangs his staff and thunders, "**Enough**!" The moons sheepishly shrink away until one remains, since one moon, as the *quotation* now admits, is **enough** for anyone.

In {Front} of the {Hangar}, the {Joker} folds each **chapter** of his joke book into a paper plane and pins a *badge* on its nose. He launches them one by one, cackling, and every time someone peels a **chapter** off their windscreen, the *badge* squirts them in the eye.

In {Front} of the {Inn}, {Yoshi} flicks out his tongue and swallows all the *music* coming from a village band, leaving them sawing away in silence. There is not a **sound** for a full minute. Then he lays a spotted egg, it cracks, and the *music* comes back as a **sound** like a trombone falling down a well.

{Gandalf} arrives in {Front} of the {Funfair} and finds that a cursed *kicking foot* has begun to **follow** him. He gives it his fiercest wizard's *glare* and sets off a firework behind it, but it goes on **following**, hopping after him through the dodgems and onto the carousel. "You shall not pass!" he roars, and it nips at his heel and passes.

The {Joker} cackles in the {Bathroom} of the {Beehive}, revealing his greatest **ambition**: to squirt the moon with his flower. A tiny *scholar* does the maths and shakes his head, but the Joker's *heart* beats so hard with **ambition** that it pumps the flower full and blasts him upward. He waves a playing card, grinning, past the clouds.

In the {Basement} of the {Beach}, {Darth Vader} raises a *shed* with the Force, breathing loudly, then lifts its *foundation* too, and still finds no **bottom** to the hole beneath. He booms his disapproval and levitates crabs and pirate gold out of the way. At the very **bottom** sits a tiny crab on a tiny chair, and he announces that he is its father.

The {Joker} climbs onto a *podium* in the {Bathroom} of the {Mansion}, because a *fortune teller* has promised a prize to anyone who can **stand** perfectly still for a hundred years. He **stands**, grin fixed, while pigeons nest in his green hair. When the day comes the prize is a chair, and it squirts him, because he rigged it himself.

{Yoshi} flutters {Inside} the {Mansion} to face a **stern** judge whose frown drops like a *cliff* and who only ever hands out a *silver medal*, never gold. He swallows the *silver medal* and lays it as an egg, hoping for a smile. The judge hands back the egg, as **stern** as ever, and marks it down for shape.

{Batman} crouches in {Front} of the {Spa} all night, brooding, and **longs for** one hot bath he can never take. Beside him a *python* sighs and **longs for** it too, writing poems about bubbles. At dawn he fires his grappling hook, swings the *python* into the tub, and glides off, gruffly refusing to admit how much he envies a snake.

{Lara Croft} vaults into the {Bathroom} of the {Beach} and plucks a *standing person* from a *lineup* of tourists for a lesson in tomb safety. Here is an **example** of what not to do, she says, as he steps on the wrong tile and a rubber boulder bonks him. The *lineup* gasps, and she cartwheels across every trap as the good **example**.

{Frodo} digs in on a *hillside* {Inside} the {Hangar}, with loyal Sam and a *square* of sandbags, to **defend** a single potato. Custard and pigeons rain down from above, so he slips on the Ring to vanish. The *square* of sandbags holds, the *hillside* rumbles, and weary, invisible Frodo keeps on **defending** that potato until the pigeons surrender.

{Zorro} vaults {Inside} the {Pool}, where a *clan* of penguins squabbles over passports showing each one's **nationality**: Emperor, King, Rockhopper. With three flicks of his rapier he slashes a Z through every passport. The *clan* blinks at the holes, and he vanishes laughing, leaving them all one **nationality**: Zorroland.

In {Front} of the {Lagoon}, {Gandalf} conjures a *standing person* from his pipe smoke, then dozens, and they form a line of *joined hands* down to the water. Along it they pass buckets that he fills by spell, to **supply** the fish with lemonade and the turtles with fireworks. "A wizard's **supply** never runs out," he says, just as it does.

{Shrek} sits with *crossed legs* in the {Bathroom} of the {Cat Café}, thumps his *cane* and lets out one huge onion belch. The **effect** is instant: every cat's fur stands up and they all float round the lampshade. The donkey begs him to do it again, so he does, the **effect** doubles, and for once there is silence.

{Shrek} stomps into the {Bathroom} of the {Museum} to escape the donkey, but a *market stall* stands there, unwinding one endless *silk thread*, and the donkey **continues** along it, talking. Shrek roars and stuffs the *silk thread* in his own ears. Still the chatter **continues**, past the dinosaurs and through the night, in layers.

In {Front} of the {Beehive}, {Sherlock} studies a crumb on a paving *square* and deduces the whole plot: a *snake* has been hired to **carry out** a honey robbery at noon. At noon the *snake* slithers across the *square* and does **carry out** the job, and swallows his deerstalker too. "Elementary," he says, hatless, while Watson takes notes.

{Lara Croft} scales the bunks {Inside} the {Youth Hostel} and lifts a glittering *keepsake* off its pedestal, and the door slams: a trap that makes anyone who touches it **stay**. She backflips, picks locks and climbs vents, but each way out seals itself. The *keepsake* hums smugly, so she sighs, unrolls a sleeping bag and **stays** another year.

In the {Basement} of the {Stadium}, {James Bond} dangles over a deep *well* and, unruffled, clicks Q's latest gadget, which does nothing but blow a *small speech bubble* that **explains** the offside rule. The bubble **explains** it so slowly that the guard at the rope nods off. The *well* yawns too, and Bond climbs out with a dry one-liner.

{Shrek} stomps {Inside} the {Boxing Ring}, shoves the chattering donkey's head through a pair of wooden *stocks* and presses his face into wet *soil* to make a mould. He labels it a **type**: annoying. Then every boxer wants a go, the *soil* keeps printing faces, and soon there is a **type** for all of them: sweaty, grumpy, snoring, and one more annoying.

{Lara Croft} drops into the {Bathroom} of the {Cat Café}, facing a pressure plate that needs an exact weight, and looks round for **material**. She swings a stone *dipper* and shovels *rice* onto the plate, grain by grain, until the wall grinds open. The cats then bring **material** of their own, yarn, feathers and tuna, and the trap jams forever.

In {Front} of the {Lagoon}, the {Joker} sneaks up behind a ferryman and tugs a loose *silk thread* on his *winter coat*. He runs, cackling, all round the water as the *winter coat* unravels, until he reaches the very **end** of the thread. There dangles a tiny playing card that reads The **End**, and he takes a bow.

{Darth Vader} looms {Inside} the {Spa}, breathing loudly, and lifts a *bamboo* basket into the air with the Force. He booms that it must **answer** him. Its *fitted lid* clacks once for yes and twice for no. He asks whether he is its father, it **answers** with a long wet raspberry, and the whole spa holds its breath.

In the {Basement} of the {Inn}, {James Bond} is trussed up in a *silk skein* that pulls itself **tight** round his tuxedo. He clicks Q's cufflink, which does one absurd thing: it makes knots even **tighter**. He hops away like a caterpillar, unruffled, and orders a drink through a straw.

{Homer} lumbers {Inside} the {Swamp} with a dim scheme to make the world's biggest custard doughnut, trips, and smashes a giant egg. A flood of *yolk* turns everything **yellow**: frogs, lily pads, a startled crocodile. "Mmm," he says, and climbs out **yellow** from head to toe, and nobody can tell the difference.

{James Bond} skates {Inside} the {Ice Rink} in his tuxedo, where a *rainbow* dangles by a single *silk thread*, and raises Q's laser watch, which can **cut off** one thing only. Snip! The *rainbow* falls and shatters into coloured ice cubes, and skaters skid in all directions. "Cool," he says, unruffled, as the manager **cuts off** his skating for life.

{Chewbacca} wanders {Inside} the {Beach} and meets an *oddball* in a tuxedo made of seaweed, walking a lobster on a lead. How **strange**, he growls, and the *oddball* growls the same thing back in perfect Wookiee. He rips open his bandolier in a panic, and it gets **stranger**: the lobster understands him as well, and offers to fix his ship.

{Charlie Brown} shuffles {Inside} the {Spa}, where a *detective* **examines** his zigzag shirt, his kite string and one lonely sock, seeking the cause of all his bad luck. Nothing there, so it is time to **examine** the football. The *detective* holds it steady, Charlie runs up to kick, and it is pulled away. "Good grief."

{Mario} slides down a warp pipe into the {Basement} of the {Pool} and head-butts a block, and out pops not a coin but his *mother*, with a towel and a snack. Like every **mother**, she straightens his red cap and wipes his moustache. He eats a mushroom, grows ten feet tall and shouts "Wahoo!", and his **mother** simply asks if he is warm enough.

{James Bond} strolls up in {Front} of the {Boxing Ring}, shakes out his pocket square, Q's most absurd gadget yet, and it unfolds into a full-size *palace*. He declares it the **capital** of a country with one citizen. Trumpets play from the *palace* windows, pigeons queue for passports, and he stands unruffled in the **capital**, stamping them.

{Darth Vader} stalks into the {Bathroom} of the {Swan Pond}, red lightsaber humming, where a *blacksmith* is hammering a long iron bar. He booms his disapproval and slices the bar into neat **sections**. The *blacksmith* shrugs and hammers each **section** into railings for the swans, as Vader breathes loudly and lifts the last one away with the Force.

In {Front} of the {Beach}, {Yoshi} flutter-jumps after a kite and loses height, so he shoots out his sticky tongue and sticks it to the *robe* of a *standing person*. Now he **depends on** that one hem to keep from falling. The person sneezes, the *robe* stretches, and Yoshi, who **depends on** the sneezing stopping, lays a nervous egg.

In {Front} of the {Beach}, {Pikachu} sits at a tiny desk while *twins* bring him plans for a sandcastle, and he **approves** each with a spark that scorches a yellow tick. A *helping hand* holds the next sheet still. "Pika!" Without reading it he **approves** that too, and it was the twins' plan to catch him in a Poké Ball.

{Chewbacca} strides {Inside} the {Dunes}, huge and hairy, and a *lord* in a velvet cape mistakes him for the biggest of his *sheep*. The whole woolly **crowd** agrees and surges after him, thousands of them, baaing. He roars in a temper and rips the cape in two, and the **crowd** just chews up the pieces and looks at him for more.

{Shrek} slams down a *workbench* in the {Bathroom} of the {Stadium} and reads out a *page* listing every **item** he needs to be left alone: moat, sign, onions, earplugs. Each time he ticks off an **item**, the donkey trots in and adds a new one to the *page*: waffles. He roars, and the *workbench* collapses.

{Gandalf} appears in the {Bathroom} of the {Pool}, exactly when he means to, and a dripping *storyteller* demands the **reason** he is so late. A wizard is never late, he snaps, blowing a smoke ring. So the *storyteller* invents one: a frog prince, a lost slipper. Each time Gandalf frowns, a firework pops and another **reason** appears in the sparks.

{Casper} floats through the wall of the {Bathroom} of the {Mansion} and tries to **press** a red button marked *safe home*, but his finger goes straight through. A *helping hand* shoots out of the tiles and **presses** it for him, and the whole mansion folds up like a tent. The butler screams at the sight of him, and poor Casper only wanted a friend.

{Homer} nods off {Inside} the {Hut} beside a leaky tap he was too lazy to fix, and the *water drops* swell and roar into a **river**. His *nodding head* bobs along on top, still asleep. The **river** carries him out to sea on a raft of doughnuts, and he wakes with "D'oh!", then "Mmm."

{Mario} head-butts a block in the {Basement} of the {Beach}, and out pops one grain of *rice* where a coin should be. He hits it again and again, shouting "Wahoo!", and **rice** gushes out of every warp pipe in the place. Plumber that he is, he stomps on the pipes and swims up through a sea of **rice**, moustache first.

{Walter White} stands {Inside} the {Lake} with a beaker, growing crystals in a perfect school experiment, and they climb up into a glittering *fence*. It spreads until it **surrounds** the ducks, the fish and his RV, each post fastened with a *leather strap*. Too late he sees that it **surrounds** him as well, so he knocks, being the one who knocks, and a swan lets him out.

In {Front} of the {Stadium}, Q slides {James Bond} a pen across a *workbench*; one click, and *water drops* start falling. They do one absurd thing, which is never stop, and soon a **river** wraps the stadium like a moat. Bond steps onto the floating *workbench* in a dry tuxedo and escapes down the **river**, one hand on his bow tie.

In {Front} of the {Beehive}, the {Joker} cackles as he pays a *lone bird* to **weave** a hammock of *silk thread*. It **weaves** in and out faster than a sewing machine, in purple and green, with one trick knot hidden in the middle. Grinning hugely, he invites the queen bee to lie down, then forgets, lies down himself and hits the ground.

{Homer} spots a *pest* in the {Bathroom} of the {Island}, a tiny beetle nibbling his doughnut, and hatches a dim scheme to **harm** it. The mallet bounces off his own toe, the bucket drops on his own bald head, and the mousetrap takes his trousers. "D'oh!" Every plan to **harm** the *pest* lands on him, while it sunbathes on the icing.

{Darth Vader} ignites his red lightsaber in the {Bathroom} of the {Boathouse} to **fight** a rower armed with only a soup *dipper*. Clang! The *dipper* bonks his helmet with a long echo, so he lifts all the soup in the place with the Force. They **fight** on, dripping, until he booms that he is the rower's father and the rower says no.

In {Front} of the {Swamp}, {Sherlock} lifts two muddy boots in *both hands* and inspects them. From one crumb of mud he deduces all: a **pair** of frogs lives in them, shares a violin and owes Watson money. "Elementary," he says, and *both hands* jump as that **pair** of frogs hops out and proves him right.

{James Bond} presses Q's latest gadget in the {Bathroom} of the {Boxing Ring}: a watch that does nothing but change his **surroundings**. Up bursts *soil* across the floor, then sunflowers, then cows in the towels. For the *finale* the tiles turn into a meadow, and he adjusts his bow tie, unruffled, and calls his new **surroundings** udderly charming.

{Kermit} flings open the {Bathroom} of the {Hut} and a *guest* strolls on into the spotlight, because he is stage-managing a chat show in there. Another **guest** follows, then chickens, then a hundred more, each expecting a song. He flails his arms, plays a banjo chord and shrieks "Yaaay!" as the last **guest** sits on him.

{James Bond} tugs a *coiled rope* from his cufflink in the {Bathroom} of the {Beach}, Q's latest absurd gadget, with a *silk thread* tied to every knot. Each knot he pulls brings a new **era**: dinosaurs, pyramids, knights. Unruffled, he orders a drink from a caveman, then raises it to the next **era** as a dinosaur queues politely behind him.

In the {Basement} of the {Island}, {Cookie Monster} meets a *fruit picker* who wants him to **pick** mangoes off the ceiling. "Me **pick** cookie!" he bellows, googly eyes spinning, and there are no cookies. So he devours the mangoes, the ladder and the basket in a spray of crumbs, and the *fruit picker*, sighing, picks crumbs out of his fur.

At a *party* in the {Basement} of the {Museum}, {James Bond} clicks Q's latest gadget, a bow tie that can **lift** exactly one thing: a marble lion. Up it floats, roaring softly, and he stays unruffled beneath it. The *party* cheers, and the statues **lift** him on their shoulders and carry him round the room, drink still unspilled.

In {Front} of the {Spa}, {Sherlock} finds one flattened mosquito and one crumb, and deduces everything: an *assassin* in a dressing gown has come with a fly swatter to **kill** every mosquito in the place. "Elementary," he says, smugly, pipe in hand. The *assassin* bows, admits it, and goes on to **kill** the next one on Sherlock's nose.

In {Front} of the {Lagoon}, {Gandalf} is lighting his pipe on a *workbench* when five hundred seagulls **attack** his sandwich. "You shall not pass!" he thunders, and enchants a *cane* to **attack** them for him. It whirls through the flock, whacking at feathers, fireworks bursting from its tip, and the gulls retreat with only the crusts.

{Frodo} slips on the Ring in the {Bathroom} of the {Pool} and turns invisible, trying to escape his *father*, who is in a stripy swimsuit telling terrible jokes. It is no use: like any **father**, he spots the hairy feet and asks if anyone wants a sandwich. Frodo groans, for a **father** like that makes Mordor look like a short walk.

In {Front} of the {Pool}, {Sailor Moon} trips over the *grass* and crashes through a *workshop*, moon wand firing sparkles in all directions. The sparkles turn every blade into giant **basil**, with leaves the size of surfboards, and the *workshop* starts humming pesto. She gives a long speech about justice while Luna, sneezing, drowns in **basil**.

{Mario} pops out of a warp pipe in the {Bathroom} of the {Beach} and head-butts a straw *roof*, which flips open on a **secret** level. Down he drops into a *hideout* stuffed with coins and mushrooms. "Wahoo!" A crab peeks in and sees the **secret**, so he pays it one coin to keep quiet.

In {Front} of the {Beach}, {Darth Vader} disapproves of a *standing person* building a hut on a weak *foundation*, so he lowers them both with the Force, breathing loudly. Down goes the *foundation*, **lower** and **lower**, until only a hat shows, very **low** indeed. He bends down, cape in the sand, to boom at the hat.

{Charlie Brown} is summoned {Inside} the {Tower} to kick the royal football before the *royal court*. Trumpets blare, lords bow, and the whole **court** holds its breath as he runs up. The queen pulls the ball away at the last second, he lands flat on his back, and the **court** applauds politely. "Good grief."

In the {Basement} of the {Boathouse}, {Yoshi} gulps down his new best *friend*, a walrus, in one affectionate slurp of his tongue. He looks guilty, then lays a huge spotted egg, which hatches to reveal his **friend** wearing the shell as a hat. A real **friend** always comes back, and this one asks to do it again.

{Sailor Moon} sobs in the {Bathroom} of the {Pool}, because a *small speech bubble* has floated up carrying a *chipped axe* and begun to **tell** its sad story. She raises her moon wand, strikes a pose, and **tells** it a far longer story about love and justice. Luna covers her ears, the *chipped axe* weeps, and both of them cry into the water.

In the {Basement} of the {Beehive}, the {Joker} holds up a trick *stop sign*, and every bee **stops** dead in mid-air, buzzing on the spot. The honey **stops** dripping, the clock **stops** ticking, and he cackles at his finest prank. Then he flips the sign, it squirts him in the face, and they all zoom off at once.

{Shrek} bursts out of the {Bathroom} of the {Beach} to escape the donkey and steps onto a *silk thread* stretched over a flooded *rice field*. The thread is **thin**, and the ogre is not. He sheds layer after layer, as ogres do, trying to get **thin** enough, until it snaps and the *rice field* swallows him with a splash and a roar.

{Yoshi} skids into the {Bathroom} of the {Mint}, where a *cliff spring* bubbles over the tiles and grants one **wish** for one coin. He gobbles the bank's coins, lays them as a golden egg and drops it in with his *heart* thumping. His **wish** comes true at once: more eggs gush out of the spring, all landing on him.

In {Front} of the {Yen Exchange}, {Chewbacca} is fixing his ship's engine when a *thousand ants* march into his fur. He roars and rips off his bandolier, but they only carry away a **thousand** tiny bolts. Then they carry them back, every one in the right place, and he growls with loyal love for his **thousand** new mechanics.

The {Joker} sneaks {Inside} the {Beehive}, where a *standing person* dangles a *plumb line* over each honeycomb to see what it is **worth**. He swaps the line for a trick one, cackling, and the next comb squirts. Then it swings at him and declares his huge grin **worth** exactly three jars of honey and a playing card.
